# Ontario Month-to-Month Lease Exit Checklist

A tenant in Ontario can usually end a month-to-month tenancy by giving proper written notice and keeping proof of delivery. Since rent is paid on the 1st, the notice should be timed to end on a rent period boundary to avoid extra rent or disputes.

## End-of-Lease Action Plan

| Item | What to verify | Target for your case |
|---|---|---|
| Notice form | Landlord requires written notice; use a clear signed notice or Ontario’s standard termination form if applicable | Prepare in writing |
| Notice length | Month-to-month notice is commonly one full rental period and must end on the last day of a rental period | End date: **2026-07-31** |
| Delivery proof | Keep a copy and proof of delivery method | Email plus read receipt, or hand delivery with witness |
| Rent cycle | Rent is due on the 1st, so the tenancy period likely runs from the 1st to the last day of the month | Notice should align to **2026-07-31** |
| Move-out condition | Avoid deductions by documenting condition and cleaning | Photos, meter readings, key return record |
| Final accounts | Confirm last rent, any prepaid amounts, and any lawful refunds | Request written confirmation |

## Notice Timeline for a 2026-07-31 Move-Out

- **By 2026-06-30:** Deliver written notice so the landlord has at least one full rental period before the July 31 end date.
- **2026-07-01 to 2026-07-15:** Confirm the landlord acknowledged receipt and accepted the move-out date.
- **2026-07-20 to 2026-07-30:** Do a move-out walkthrough, photograph the unit, and note any repair concerns.
- **2026-07-31:** Return keys, parking fobs, and any access devices; keep a dated receipt or email confirmation.
- **After move-out:** Save rent receipts, notice copy, and final correspondence in case of any deposit or penalty dispute.

## Tenant Checklist to Avoid Penalties

- Use **written notice only**; do not rely on a verbal conversation.
- State the exact termination date: **July 31, 2026**.
- Make sure the notice is served in a way the landlord can proveably receive.
- Do not leave before the agreed end date unless the landlord confirms an earlier release in writing.
- Ask whether the landlord wants the notice in a specific format.
- Keep copies of everything: notice, email thread, delivery proof, photos, and key return record.
- Confirm whether any final rent payment is still due through July 31.
- Ask for written confirmation that the tenancy ends with no further amounts owed, except lawful charges if any apply.

## Email Template Requesting Confirmation

**Subject:** Notice of End of Tenancy and Request for Confirmation

Hello [Landlord Name],

I am writing to provide written notice that I will be ending my month-to-month tenancy at [rental address] effective **July 31, 2026**.

Please confirm in writing that you have received this notice and that my tenancy will end on **2026-07-31**. If you would like the notice in any specific format, please let me know.

I will ensure the unit is returned in good condition, with all keys and access devices returned on move-out day.

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Phone Number]
[Email Address]
